@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: We're going to have a Halloween party next Friday, so I'm thinking about what kind of c______e I should wear.
= costume
~詞義 costume（n.）服裝
~原文 We're going to have a Halloween party next Friday, so I'm thinking about what kind of costume I should wear.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The student is not very familiar with the university grounds because he is just a f______n.
= freshman
~詞義 freshman（n.）新生
~原文 The student is not very familiar with the university grounds because he is just a freshman.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Though Mr. Williams was born into a poor family, he worked hard and managed to become a m______e.
= millionaire
~詞義 millionaire（n.）百萬富翁
~原文 Though Mr. Williams was born into a poor family, he worked hard and managed to become a millionaire.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: It was c______s of the captain to rescue several sailors from the sinking ship.
= courageous
~詞義 courageous（adj.）勇敢的
~原文 It was courageous of the captain to rescue several sailors from the sinking ship.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The hotel we stayed in was so l______s that I felt like I was staying in a palace.
= luxurious
~詞義 luxurious（adj.）豪華的
~原文 The hotel we stayed in was so luxurious that I felt like I was staying in a palace.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Studying abroad is a good opportunity to expand your ______.
A: monuments
B: horizons
C: cottages
D: bracelets
= B
~詞義 horizon（n.）視野
~原文 Studying abroad is a good opportunity to expand your horizons.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: We live in a(n) ______ of instant communication. Through social networking sites and messaging apps, it's very easy for us to stay in touch with others.
A: era
B: hive
C: bin
D: atom
= A
~詞義 era（n.）時代
~原文 We live in a(n) era of instant communication. Through social networking sites and messaging apps, it's very easy for us to stay in touch with others.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The teacher ______ students with the lab rules before letting them do experiments on their own.
A: awaited
B: acquainted
C: resolved
D: drafted
= B
~詞義 acquaint（v.）使熟悉
~原文 The teacher acquainted students with the lab rules before letting them do experiments on their own.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: It was a miracle that the patient fully recovered from a severe ______.
A: hose
B: frost
C: craft
D: stroke
= D
~詞義 stroke（n.）中風
~原文 It was a miracle that the patient fully recovered from a severe stroke.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: My grandmother just had ______ on her knees, so she has to use a wheelchair for the next few months.
A: council
B: audio
C: surgery
D: privacy
= C
~詞義 surgery（n.）外科手術
~原文 My grandmother just had surgery on her knees, so she has to use a wheelchair for the next few months.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: technological
B: misunderstand
C: succeed
D: poisonous
E: atomic
F: sympathies

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Please don't ______ what I said. I did say that Gina could do better, but it doesn't mean that I want to fire her.
= B
~詞義 misunderstand（v.）誤解
~原文 Please don't misunderstand what I said. I did say that Gina could do better, but it doesn't mean that I want to fire her.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: ______ advances have changed how students learn, allowing them to access information quickly through the Internet.
= A
~詞義 technological（adj.）科技的
~原文 Technological advances have changed how students learn, allowing them to access information quickly through the Internet.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Bella hoped to ______ in balancing schoolwork and part-time jobs without losing her energy or motivation.
= C
~詞義 succeed（v.）成功
~原文 Bella hoped to succeed in balancing schoolwork and part-time jobs without losing her energy or motivation.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: In this book on how to survive in the wild, there is a chapter on which fruit and vegetables one can eat and which ones are ______.
= D
~詞義 poisonous（adj.）有毒的
~原文 In this book on how to survive in the wild, there is a chapter on which fruit and vegetables one can eat and which ones are poisonous.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Please accept my deepest ______ on the loss of your father.
= F
~詞義 sympathy（n.）慰問
~原文 Please accept my deepest sympathies on the loss of your father.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: acquaintance
B: leaned
C: counter
D: respectful
E: audible
F: proceeded

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Ian is just a casual ______. We chat for a bit when we run into each other, but I don't really know him well.
= A
~詞義 acquaintance（n.）點頭之交
~原文 Ian is just a casual acquaintance. We chat for a bit when we run into each other, but I don't really know him well.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Lisa has good manners. For example, she is ______ to her elders and kind to her juniors.
= D
~詞義 respectful（adj.）尊敬的
~原文 Lisa has good manners. For example, she is respectful to her elders and kind to her juniors.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: After I finished cleaning my bedroom, I ______ to paint its walls.
= F
~詞義 proceed（v.）繼續進行
~原文 After I finished cleaning my bedroom, I proceeded to paint its walls.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: The store clerk ______ the ladder against the wall so she could reach the top shelf safely.
= B
~詞義 lean（v.）倚;靠(lean… against…)
~原文 The store clerk leaned the ladder against the wall so she could reach the top shelf safely.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: After arriving at the airport, the passenger headed straight for the check-in ______.
= C
~詞義 counter（n.）櫃臺
~原文 After arriving at the airport, the passenger headed straight for the check-in counter.
